sources.entry: Lark - The Next-Gen Collaboration Suite. All your chats, meetings, calendars, docs, and emails in one place. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Lark
summary.one_liner: Lark is a productivity superapp for teams that combines chat, video meetings, docs, calendar, email, workflow automation and AI in one platform.
keywords: work chat and docs in one place
use_cases: consolidating software tools to cut costs
summary.what_it_does: Lark is presented as an all-in-one collaboration suite covering chat, meetings, calendars, docs, email and projects. It includes Lark AI, which the page says can automate workflows and support tasks such as trend spotting, generating multi-channel assets and detecting customer intent. The page describes a Base feature with rows and tables and an automation count per plan, so it appears to include a spreadsheet-style database with automations. Pricing is tiered by user count and storage, with Starter at $0 per user per month for up to 20 users and paid Basic, Pro and Enterprise tiers. The page itself is mostly marketing, so claims like productivity gains and cost savings are unverified.
notable: Includes a free Starter tier at $0 per user per month
Lark AI for workflow automation and assistance across the suite
Base spreadsheet-style database with automation limits per plan
Listed in awesome-mac as a freeware collaboration tool
caveats: Paid Basic ($6), Pro ($12) and Enterprise tiers have per-user or custom pricing
Starter tier is capped at 20 users and 100 GB storage
Advanced Base permissions and security controls are limited to higher tiers
Productivity and cost-saving figures on the page are vendor marketing claims
